title: Do They See the Same Moon?

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: On a clear night, a child asks whether people on the far side of the sea are looking at the same moon right now.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: On a clear night, (name1), a child, asks whether people on the far side of the sea are looking at the same moon right now.

choices.label: Ask What They Might Feel Looking Up.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: An elder says that if anyone is out there, the moon would be the one thing everyone shares; the child waves at it, just in case.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A navigator points out that it might be daytime somewhere else, and the child is astonished that the moon could be "taking turns."

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar wonders whether distant lands might see different stars; the idea makes the night feel larger.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A skeptic says there is no way to know, and the child decides to keep both ideas.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A parent imagines a distant parent pointing at the moon for a sleepy child; the village falls quiet.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A fisher says perhaps some people are too busy to look up at all, and everyone laughs because they know someone like that.
